what_happened: All three gating prerequisites (870 saturation_of_orientedForest, 871 lcN_reflectTime_plusValidZTime, 867 separationOver_ztime) are verified landed in the tree by grep before the architecture was written; 867 landed the same morning as this dispatch, so the 865 report's 'gate' on separation is now discharged.

The three target completeness statements (T1 literal LC_n/no rules, T2 LC_n + rules, T3 LCU + rules) and the extended derivation inductive elaborated on the first attempt under import FormalSystem via lean_run_code; saved as probes/01_target-statements.lean.

audit-task-proposals.sh emits a covered-by-closed verdict for essentially every closed record at low semantic scores (hundreds per proposal) alongside the designed scope-blind flood; the meaningful verdicts (duplicate-of-open 430, subset-of-open 869) had to be extracted by jq filtering. Recorded as display noise, not a defect of the matcher.

The dispatch asks to file each missing ingredient as its own task through the backlog audit, but the formal-research-agent contract has no task-creation surface; followed the 865 precedent: task-proposals.json written and audited (task-proposals-audit.ndjson), creation left to /task or the orchestrator's proposal intake.

Plan-time audit triage of the nine filed proposals found exactly one substantive-file overlap (P6 plus_invariance_base_without_saturation vs open task 869 on FormalSystem/Semantics/HistoryMorphism.lean); every other open-side verdict is on aggregator files only (docs/theorem-index.md, scripts/check-module-invariants.sh, FormalSystem.lean), so the filing phase needs one dependency edge, not nine.

Phase 1 disposition pass clean: all nine proposals are genuinely-new or aggregator-only overlaps except P6/869 (substantive overlap on HistoryMorphism.lean, serialization edge 869 <- P6 planned); condensed audit NDJSON is 9 lines of 4.7-51.1 KB, well under state-write.sh's per-argv ceiling

state-write.sh --audit-verdict passes the whole slurped evidence file as a single --argjson argv; the 9-line condensed file (346 KB total, every line under 52 KB) still exceeded MAX_ARG_STRLEN=131072 ('Argument list too long' at state-write.sh line 778). Workaround: one single-line slice per proposal, generated from the committed condensed file into the session scratchpad, passed per filing call.

update-task-status.sh --depends-on-add cannot target a not_started task: map_status() has no operation:target_status pair resolving to not_started (the gap orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh's resolve_noop_token() already documents). The 869 <- 898 serialization edge was added via state-write.sh under the mutex with an append-only filter on 869's dependencies; validate-state.sh's Kahn cycle check run afterwards.

tests/test-roadmap-generation.sh exits 2 (environment) in a deployed-only tree: it resolves roadmap-integration.sh in source-store mode with no deploy-tree fallback, and this repo has no agent-system/ directory. The suite is fixture-based and does not read the real ROADMAP.md; Phase 3 closed COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS with roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate --dry-run (exit 0) as the substitute round-trip evidence.

Phase 4 close-out: summary validated with validate-artifact.sh (0 warnings) on first write; FormalSystem/ and Tests/ byte-identical across the task's three phase commits; full gate deferred to the batch stage per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, scoped tier run in-dispatch.

Every test suite that resolves its subject in source-store mode (test-roadmap-generation.sh, test-generate-task-order.sh, test-update-task-status.sh observed) exits 2 'not found (mode=source-store)' in this deployed-only tree, which has no agent-system/ directory and no source_dir in .claude-extensions.json. Content-independent; the batch-level full gate will report the same class.
